checks: Chat and semantic reservations settle together and identical retries do not rerun the callback
Duplicate or repeated primary ids are rejected without consuming any reservation
A settled primary cannot be reused to charge a newly held additional reservation
Cross-account additional reservation ids cannot join a settlement group
Callback failure rolls back both ledger settlements before the caller refunds the two holds
A refunded additional reservation prevents the primary from being settled
Group size and malformed id values are bounded before any ledger mutation
scope: Actual isolated SQLite ledger with synthetic accounts, no payments/provider calls.
